results.excerpt: Rate limit incident Q3 2024: API consumers were not warned 24 hours before the rate limit threshold was lowered from 1000 to 500 requests per minute. Several clients experienced outages lasting 2-4 hours.
Lessons learned: (1) All limit changes require 72-hour advance notice. (2) Clients must have a documented escalation path. (3) Rate limit headers should be included in all API responses.

output_document.summary: The Q3 2024 API rate limits incident resulted when rate thresholds were lowered from 1000 to 500 requests per minute without the mandatory 24-hour advance notice, causing clients 2-4 hour outages. Key lessons learned: (1) all limit changes require 72-hour advance notice, (2) clients must have documented escalation paths, and (3) rate limit headers must be included in all API responses. These findings should inform the webhooks feature by ensuring change notifications are proactive, clients have clear communication channels, and real-time rate limit visibility is built into the system.
